biography.title: Biography
biography.p1: Born in Bursa in 1980. He graduated from Selçuk University State Conservatory, Department of Acting in 2005.
biography.p2: He started his career at Bursa State Theater and was deemed worthy of the Direklerarası Lions Kerem Yılmazer Young Talent Award for his performance in 'A Very Original Play'.
biography.p3: He continues his work as a director, actor, and producer in international projects based in Switzerland and the Netherlands. He signs global projects with his own production company, Time Right Production.

intro.sinema: A 20-year journey in front of the camera. Feature films honored at international festivals, Turkey’s most-watched TV series, and projects for leading digital platforms..
intro.theater: Selected frames from theater stages reflect the artist's stage presence and character depth, offering special excerpts from contemporary and classical works.
intro.producion: Under the umbrella of Time Right Production, the work carried out by Zafer Altun extends into Europe through his roles as producer and instructor. Serving as the line producer for projects such as Edel Stal Group’s documentary film Simtronik and various international commercial series—primarily in Switzerland and the Netherlands—Altun merges this production-oriented vision with education. Through the acting workshops he conducts and the stage productions he directs in Zurich and Rotterdam, he continues to share his industry experience on a global scale.

about.title: About
about.description: Detailed information about the artistic journey, international projects, and educational work of actor, director, and acting coach Zafer Altun.
about.intro: Born in Bursa in 1980, Zafer Altun is a versatile artist who combines his work on stage and in front of the camera with directing, producing, and acting coaching. After graduating from the Acting Department of Selçuk University State Conservatory in 2005, he began his career at Bursa State Theater.
about.background: Following his conservatory training, Altun gained experience in state theater and was awarded the Direklerarası 9th Lions Kerem Yılmazer Young Talent of the Year Award for his performance in 'A Very Original Play'. This award marked a significant turning point in terms of character depth and technical discipline in his stage performances.
about.career: His work in cinema and television includes feature films honored at international festivals and projects from Turkey's most-watched series. Through productions such as 'The Fish', 'The Dream', 'Indifferent', and 'The Truth of the Matter', he has contributed both as an actor and as a creative team member.
about.international: Continuing his Europe-based work primarily in Switzerland and the Netherlands, Altun serves as line producer for international commercial series, documentary films, and theater projects through his own production company, Time Right Production. The Edel Stal Group documentary 'Simtronik' is among these works.
about.education: Through acting workshops he conducts in Zurich and Rotterdam, he teaches theater acting, on-camera acting, diction, effective speaking, and audition techniques. He also applies personal skills such as percussion, horse riding, sword fighting, and driving in his professional projects.
about.approach: Maintaining a production practice across Istanbul, Switzerland, and the Netherlands, he continues to train actors for both stage and screen by combining artistic experience with education.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for the official Zafer Altun website.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.content: Zafer Altun ('we') respects the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is handled when you visit our official website at altunzafer.com.

collectedData.title: 2. Information We Collect
collectedData.content: Our site does not require membership or form submission. When you contact us by email, phone, or social media, the information you provide—such as your name, email address, phone number, and message content—is used solely to respond to your inquiry.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.content: Your contact details are used to respond to artistic collaborations, production projects, acting workshops, and management inquiries. We do not use your information for marketing purposes or contact you without consent.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Analytics
cookies.content: Our website does not use third-party cookies, tracking pixels, or analytics tools. Browser information and browsing behavior are not collected directly by us. The site uses Cloudflare R2 CDN for image delivery.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.content: Information shared with us through contact channels may be retained for a reasonable period after your request is completed. You may request deletion at any time by emailing info@altunzafer.com.

thirdParties.title: 6. Sharing with Third Parties
thirdParties.content: Personal data is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for commercial purposes. Information may only be disclosed in response to legal obligations or authorized authority requests.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, and object to the processing of the personal data you have provided to us. To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@altunzafer.com.

contact.title: 8. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@altunzafer.com.
